description: Source code for QuicReceivedPacketManager class, managing received packet acknowledgments in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages received packets, tracking acknowledgments, missing packets, and ACK frame generation in QUIC.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures ACK behavior based on provided QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records receipt of a packet, updating acknowledgment state and statistics.

methods.name: IsMissing
methods.description: Checks if a packet is missing based on acknowledgment frame.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Determines if a packet is still awaited based on acknowledgment frame.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Generates an updated ACK frame with current acknowledgment information.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Stops waiting for packets before a specified packet number.

methods.name: GetMaxAckDelay
methods.description: Calculates maximum delay before sending an ACK based on RTT and configuration.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckFrequency
methods.description: Adjusts acknowledgment frequency based on received packets.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Updates ACK timeout based on packet receipt and missing packets.

methods.name: HasMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are missing packets.

methods.name: HasNewMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are new missing packets suitable for immediate acknowledgment.

methods.name: ack_frame_updated
methods.description: Returns whether the ACK frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest acknowledged packet number observed.

methods.name: PeerFirstSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the first packet number sent by the peer.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACK frame contains no packets.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming ACK frequency frames to adjust acknowledgment behavior.
